messages:
snapshot-bot: Alert: snapshot-restore-failed (rule: snapshot-decrypt-error). Snapshot snap-0a1b2c3d attempted restore in prod-az1 returned KMSAccessDeniedException.
emma-oncall: I'm seeing customer restore job ID r-8f7e9a failing in restore-runner logs: 
```
2026-05-10T14:00:02Z ERROR restore-runner: failed to decrypt snapshot header: KMSAccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/restore-runner-role-session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd-1234
```
emma-oncall: this is blocking a scheduled restore for tenant: tenant-omega. any ideas?
fred-backups: preliminary check: snapshot snap-0a1b2c3d was created with CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd-1234 from the backup account (333333333333). The restore-runner is in the serving account (222222222222). We usually create a Grant when snapshot is exported for cross-account restore.
gina-sec: can you grab the KMS grant list and the createGrant CloudTrail event for that snapshot? also check key policy for cross-account statements.
fred-backups: running quick commands now:
```
# list active grants for the CMK
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd-1234

# cloudtrail lookup
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateGrant --start-time 2026-05-09T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-10T15:00:00Z
```
fred-backups: result: there IS a CreateGrant at 2026-05-09T12:15:00Z -> GrantId: 1234-5678, GranteePrincipal: arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/restore-runner-role-session, Operations: [Encrypt,Decrypt,ReEncryptFrom,ReEncryptTo,GenerateDataKey], CreationDate: 2026-05-09T12:15:00Z, Constraints: {EncryptionContextSubset: {SnapshotId: "snap-0a1b2c3d"}, GrantTokens: []}, RetiringPrincipal: arn:aws:iam::333333333333:role/grant-manager
fred-backups: BUT list-grants shows grant 1234-5678 is not present (expired). puzzling. CloudTrail CreateGrant also shows an auto-expire param?
harry-platform: jump in: we recently deployed grant-ttl change in backup-orchestration service (PR #892). TTL default was 24h, PR accidentally set default to 1h for auto-created grants when exporting snapshots. that would explain expiry before the restore job ran.
gina-sec: why did restore-runner wait until after TTL? was the restore scheduled much later than export? need timeline.
emma-oncall: snapshot exported at 2026-05-09T12:10Z, CreateGrant at 12:15Z, tenant scheduled restore started at 2026-05-10T13:58Z -> ~25.5 hours later. grant TTL 1h expired long before.
harry-platform: confirmed. root cause: grant-ttl regression in backup-orchestration. we'll roll the PR back and patch to use 30d default.
gina-sec: remediation plan: (1) re-create grant for the CMK scoped to the restore-runner principal with longer TTL (prefer 7d or 30d) and immediately retry the restore; (2) for completed restores, rotate data keys and re-encrypt if needed; (3) add CI check that simulates cross-account restore and verifies grant survival for >24h; (4) create metric/alert for GrantNotFound errors in restore-runner; (5) update key policy to allow backup-manager role to create grants without manual ops.
fred-backups: re-create grant command: 
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd-1234 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/restore-runner-role-session \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo GenerateDataKey \
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={SnapshotId=snap-0a1b2c3d} \
  --name "restore-snap-snap-0a1b2c3d-grant"
```
emma-oncall: i re-created grant 9876-5432 and retried restore -> restore-runner logs now show header decrypted and restore progressed to data streaming. :tada:
harry-platform: patch PR opened to fix TTL default and add unit test. assigning @fred-backups to follow up on rollout.
gina-sec: follow-ups for compliance/audit: (a) log the grant-create with justification into the incident record; (b) update runbooks to include a canary snapshot restore within 2h of export for cross-account flows; (c) add CloudTrail alert for CreateGrant with TTL < 24h (suspicious).
emma-oncall: small note: no ciphertext was exposed at rest, this was a restoration-time decryption failure, so low risk for data leakage. still flagging for customers as "operational delay" not "exposure" unless further evidence.
fred-backups: will add postmortem and link PRs. also adding a short-term monitor that queries list-grants for recent exports and warns if count==0.
gina-sec: good. also file a follow-up to review key policy roles and remove any overly permissive wildcard grants.
emma-oncall: closing loop: restore completed for tenant-omega at 2026-05-10T15:40Z. incident INC-2026-05-10-021 created and assigned to fred-backups for postmortem and runbook updates.
